statement: Extend the existing readonly query execution and retained-read-view seam with worker-owned SQLite connections and generation-safe cancellation, only after proving a supported interruption mechanism for the pinned native binding. Preserve current SQL admission, partition locality, resource budgets, guest runtime and Raft/apply ownership; prove bounded cleanup and continued control progress under the production workload using the normative continuation in solve/specs/pilot-readiness-and-public-proof/scale-failure-certification.md.

constraints.statement: Initial completion is 0.5 after retained-read-view-generation-custody and the stabilization owner's admitted formation/CDC/checkpoint prerequisites. Consume existing Q3/Q11/H4 contracts and preserve their sealed records. This bounded continuation does not add cluster CancelRequest, global snapshots or worker migration of committed apply.

First pin the actual SQLite binding API/version, callback thread/context, connection-scoped effects and lifetime rules. Demonstrate a supported native path that can observe cancellation during a long query before its first row. A shared atomic flag or queued worker message alone is not interruption; unsupported native hooks, microsecond latency and unmeasured hard bounds are not assumed. Name any necessary binding extension and its owner before sealing, or record the blocker and bounded refusal.

The reviewed guest runtime already runs JCO-derived modules in a V8 Worker; Wasmtime fuel/epoch is not its API. Extend existing query/read-view and admission ownership without a second guest engine, catalog, scheduler or queue. Every connection, request, cancel and reply is bound to its exact storage and worker incarnation.

Keep resource quiescence, durable operation outcome and consistency scope separate. User cancellation cannot interrupt a committed Raft apply transaction or shared Raft storage; preserve Ready/persist/apply ordering and the existing atomic data/applied-state transaction. Lost durable evidence may remain unknown rather than trigger automatic re-execution.

This registration is unsealed and creates no execution evidence. Preregister named-hardware queue, cancellation-to-quiescence, event-loop/control-progress and retained-resource bounds with adverse schedules, then obtain an actual production-owner red measurement before sealing. Collect exact-candidate supported-worker lab receipts, red-on-removal witnesses and independent verification before closure; source inspection or a missing receipt alone cannot satisfy the gate.
